title: Virgo 重力波干涉儀
summary: 以義大利卡希納 EGO 的 Advanced Virgo 為對象，從 3 km 臂腔的自由光譜範圍與線寬出發，解析卡希納近海站址的地震雜訊為何需要約 9 m 高、以倒立擺預隔離的超級衰減器，42 kg 熔融石英鏡的熱透鏡如何用 CO₂ 雷射補償，牛頓雜訊、牛頓校正器與 1.2 m 真空管殘氣如何進入靈敏度預算，以及三站網路的天區定位與運行交接。

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 超級衰減器隔振預算練習（教學假設）：10 Hz 的地面位移 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz。倒立擺調到 0.04 Hz，傳遞率 (0.04/10)² = 1.6×10⁻⁵；五級機械濾波器各 0.4 Hz，傳遞率 (0.4/10)¹⁰ = 1.05×10⁻¹⁴；理論總衰減 1.7×10⁻¹⁹，鏡子水平殘餘 1.7×10⁻²⁸ m/√Hz。實際上交叉耦合把衰減限制在約 10⁻¹²，殘餘 10⁻²¹ m/√Hz，對應 h = 10⁻²¹/3000 ≈ 3.3×10⁻²⁵/√Hz，仍比 10 Hz 處約 10⁻²³ 的設計目標低 30 倍。垂直方向：若垂直殘餘也為 10⁻²¹ m/√Hz，地球曲率使兩端局部鉛垂線相差 L/R_E = 3000/6.37×10⁶ ≈ 4.7×10⁻⁴ rad，加上機械失準取總耦合 1%，水平等效為 10⁻²³ m/√Hz，可忽略。結論是 10 Hz 的真正邊界不是地震而是懸吊熱雜訊、控制雜訊與牛頓雜訊。數值為教學假設。
workedExample.textEn: Superattenuator isolation-budget exercise (teaching assumptions): ground displacement at 10 Hz is 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz. The inverted pendulum tuned to 0.04 Hz transmits (0.04/10)² = 1.6×10⁻⁵; five mechanical filters at 0.4 Hz each transmit (0.4/10)¹⁰ = 1.05×10⁻¹⁴; the theoretical total attenuation is 1.7×10⁻¹⁹ and the residual horizontal mirror motion 1.7×10⁻²⁸ m/√Hz. In practice cross-couplings cap the attenuation near 10⁻¹², leaving 10⁻²¹ m/√Hz, or h = 10⁻²¹/3000 ≈ 3.3×10⁻²⁵/√Hz, still 30 times below the design target of about 10⁻²³ at 10 Hz. Vertically: if the vertical residual is also 10⁻²¹ m/√Hz, Earth curvature makes the local verticals at the two ends differ by L/R_E = 3000/6.37×10⁶ ≈ 4.7×10⁻⁴ rad, and taking 1% total coupling including mechanical misalignment gives a horizontal equivalent of 10⁻²³ m/√Hz, negligible. The conclusion is that the real boundary at 10 Hz is not seismic motion but suspension thermal, control and Newtonian noise. Values are teaching assumptions.

workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.

steps.title: 3 km 臂的共振參數與應變尺度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Resonance parameters and strain scale of 3 km arms: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「3 km 臂腔與自由光譜範圍」如何決定Virgo 重力波干涉儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “3 km arm cavities and free spectral range” determines the key performance of “Virgo gravitational-wave interferometer”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Virgo 是臂長 3 km 的功率循環 Fabry–Pérot 麥克森干涉儀，兩臂互相垂直，1064 nm 雷射在分光鏡分成兩束，臂端鏡把光送回分光鏡在輸出埠以暗紋干涉。臂腔的自由光譜範圍由臂長決定，線寬由精細度決定，腔極點則是訊號響應開始下降的頻率；臂長 3 km 而非 4 km，表示在相同精細度與功率下，對同一應變的相位訊號小 25%，因此 Virgo 的設計更倚重低頻隔振與高功率來補償。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「3 km 臂腔與自由光譜範圍」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Virgo is a power-recycled Fabry–Pérot Michelson interferometer with perpendicular 3 km arms; a 1064 nm laser is split at the beam splitter and the end mirrors return the light to interfere on a dark fringe at the output port. The free spectral range of an arm cavity is set by its length, the linewidth by its finesse and the cavity pole is the frequency where signal response begins to fall; arms of 3 km rather than 4 km mean that for the same finesse and power the phase signal from a given strain is 25% smaller, so the Virgo design leans harder on low-frequency isolation and high power to compensate. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “3 km arm cavities and free spectral range”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：自由光譜範圍 FSR = c/(2L) = 3×10⁸/6000 = 50 kHz；精細度 F ≈ 450 時線寬 FSR/F ≈ 111 Hz，腔極點 f_p = c/(4LF) = 3×10⁸/(4×3000×450) ≈ 56 Hz。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Free spectral range FSR = c/(2L) = 3×10⁸/6000 = 50 kHz; with finesse F ≈ 450 the linewidth is FSR/F ≈ 111 Hz and the cavity pole f_p = c/(4LF) = 3×10⁸/(4×3000×450) ≈ 56 Hz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「臂長 3 km 與 4 km 的差別只是場地大小，與靈敏度無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The difference between 3 km and 4 km arms is only site size, not sensitivity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「3 km 臂腔與自由光譜範圍」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “3 km arm cavities and free spectral range”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 3 km 臂的共振參數與應變尺度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Resonance parameters and strain scale of 3 km arms: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「3 km 臂腔與自由光譜範圍」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “3 km arm cavities and free spectral range” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：自由光譜範圍 FSR = c/(2L) = 3×10⁸/6000 = 50 kHz；精細度 F ≈ 450 時線寬 FSR/F ≈ 111 Hz，腔極點 f_p = c/(4LF) = 3×10⁸/(4×3000×450) ≈ 56 Hz。應變 h = 3.3×10⁻²² 對應 ΔL = h·L ≈ 1×10⁻¹⁸ m，約為質子直徑的千分之一。散粒雜訊應變正比於 1/(F·L)，故同精細度、同功率下 3 km 臂的散粒雜訊比 4 km 臂高 4/3 ≈ 1.33 倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Free spectral range FSR = c/(2L) = 3×10⁸/6000 = 50 kHz; with finesse F ≈ 450 the linewidth is FSR/F ≈ 111 Hz and the cavity pole f_p = c/(4LF) = 3×10⁸/(4×3000×450) ≈ 56 Hz. A strain h = 3.3×10⁻²² corresponds to ΔL = h·L ≈ 1×10⁻¹⁸ m, about one thousandth of a proton diameter. Shot-noise strain scales as 1/(F·L), so at equal finesse and power 3 km arms carry 4/3 ≈ 1.33 times the shot noise of 4 km arms. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以雷射頻率掃描臂腔，記錄透射峰的間距與寬度：峰距應為 50 kHz、峰寬約 111 Hz，由此得到實際精細度；再以已知的末端鏡驅動做掃頻，量差動臂長到輸出訊號的轉移函數，確認腔極點在 56 Hz 附近且與精細度一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Sweep the laser frequency across an arm cavity and record the spacing and width of the transmission peaks: the spacing should be 50 kHz and the width about 111 Hz, giving the actual finesse; then drive an end mirror with a swept sine and measure the transfer function from differential arm length to the output signal, confirming a cavity pole near 56 Hz consistent with the finesse.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.instruction: 以雷射頻率掃描臂腔，記錄透射峰的間距與寬度：峰距應為 50 kHz、峰寬約 111 Hz，由此得到實際精細度；再以已知的末端鏡驅動做掃頻，量差動臂長到輸出訊號的轉移函數，確認腔極點在 56 Hz 附近且與精細度一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cascina seismometers and ocean microseism” determines the key performance of “Virgo gravitational-wave interferometer”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 卡希納位於比薩附近的平原、距海岸不遠，地面在 0.2–0.5 Hz 的海洋微震振幅達微米等級，在 10 Hz 附近約 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz，且隨天氣與人類活動變化。重力波頻帶從約 10 Hz 開始，而測試質量在 10 Hz 允許的運動只有 10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz 等級，所以隔振系統必須提供十個數量級的衰減，並且在遠低於 10 Hz 的地方就開始生效；這就是 Virgo 從一開始便把低頻性能當作核心設計目標、發展超級衰減器的原因。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「卡希納站址地震計與海洋微震」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Required attenuation A = x_ground/x_allowed = 10⁻⁹/10⁻¹⁹ = 10¹⁰ at 10 Hz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「地震雜訊只在地震發生時才重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 地震雜訊與低頻隔振需求：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：所需衰減 A = x_ground/x_allowed = 10⁻⁹/10⁻¹⁹ = 10¹⁰（10 Hz）。單級擺在共振 f₀ 以上的傳遞率 ≈ (f₀/f)²：f₀ = 0.5 Hz 時在 10 Hz 為 2.5×10⁻³；要達到 10⁻¹⁰ 需要 n 級使 (2.5×10⁻³)ⁿ ≤ 10⁻¹⁰，即 n ≥ 10/2.6 ≈ 3.9，至少四級；六級則給出 (2.5×10⁻³)⁶ ≈ 2.4×10⁻¹⁶ 的理論餘裕。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。

steps.observation: 如何核對：以站址地震計記錄一年中安靜與風暴日的地面位移譜，建立 10%、50%、90% 百分位曲線；把它乘以隔振系統的量測傳遞函數，與干涉儀中測試質量的實際殘餘運動（由控制訊號反推）比較，兩者在 1–10 Hz 應一致，否則存在未建模的耦合路徑。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record ground-displacement spectra on quiet and stormy days through a year with the site seismometers and build 10th, 50th and 90th percentile curves; multiply them by the measured transfer function of the isolation system and compare with the actual residual test-mass motion inferred from control signals, which should agree between 1 and 10 Hz, otherwise an unmodelled coupling path exists.

steps.instruction: 超級衰減器高約 9 m：頂端是三根彈性接頭支撐的倒立擺，把水平共振頻率調到數十毫赫茲作為預隔離並提供低頻主動控制的介面；其下串接數級機械濾波器，每級以鋼製刀口懸吊提供水平擺動隔離，並以磁性反彈簧把垂直共振壓到 0.4 Hz 以下，解決垂直振動透過地球曲率與機械耦合漏進水平方向的問題；最下方是操縱盤（marionette）、反作用質量與鏡子。整條鏈以被動方式在 10 Hz 以上提供超過十個數量級的衰減，主動控制只負責抑制共振與低頻漂移。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「倒立擺與機械濾波器鏈」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “42 kg fused-silica mirrors and CO₂ thermal-compensation system” determines the key performance of “Virgo gravitational-wave interferometer”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Advanced Virgo 的測試質量是直徑 35 cm、厚 20 cm、重 42 kg 的熔融石英鏡，以熔融石英纖維從操縱盤單體懸吊，鍍膜由里昂的 LMA 完成。臂內數十到數百 kW 的功率即使只被鍍膜吸收不到 1 ppm，也會在鏡面中心形成溫度梯度，透過 dn/dT 在輸入鏡基板產生熱透鏡、並使鏡面曲率改變，破壞循環腔的模式匹配。熱補償系統用 CO₂ 雷射在補償板上投射環狀加熱圖案，並以環形加熱器微調鏡面曲率，把熱透鏡抵消到設計公差內。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「42 kg 熔融石英鏡與 CO₂ 熱補償系統」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Advanced Virgo's test masses are fused-silica mirrors 35 cm across, 20 cm thick and 42 kg, hung monolithically from the marionette by fused-silica fibres, with coatings made at LMA in Lyon. The thermal compensation system projects ring-shaped heating patterns from CO₂ lasers onto compensation plates and trims mirror curvature with ring heaters, cancelling the thermal lens to within the design tolerance. steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「42 kg 熔融石英鏡與 CO₂ 熱補償系統」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：薄碟熱透鏡焦距近似 f_th ≈ π·κ·w²/(P_abs·dn/dT)。取熔融石英 κ = 1.38 W/(m·K)、dn/dT = 1.2×10⁻⁵/K、光斑半徑 w = 5 cm、臂內 100 kW 被鍍膜吸收 0.5 ppm 得 P_abs = 50 mW：f_th ≈ π×1.38×2.5×10⁻³/(0.05×1.2×10⁻⁵) ≈ 0.0108/6×10⁻⁷ ≈ 1.8×10⁴ m。對邊際穩定的循環腔，18 km 的透鏡已足以改變腔的高斯模態，所以補償必須把等效焦距推到數百 km 以上。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。

For a marginally stable recycling cavity an 18 km lens already changes the cavity's Gaussian mode, so compensation must push the effective focal length beyond several hundred kilometres. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以 Hartmann 波前感測器透過輸入鏡量熱透鏡的光程差分佈，隨功率提升記錄曲率變化；開啟熱補償後確認殘餘光程差低於數十奈米，並以循環腔的高階模態含量（由相機看模式形狀）與循環增益回升來佐證。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the optical-path-difference map of the thermal lens through the input mirror with a Hartmann wavefront sensor, logging the curvature change as power rises; after enabling thermal compensation confirm that the residual optical path is below tens of nanometres, supported by the higher-order-mode content of the recycling cavity (mode shape on a camera) and the recovery of recycling gain.

steps.title: 牛頓雜訊、散射光與環境耦合：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Newtonian noise, scattered light and environmental coupling: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「站址密度起伏與牛頓雜訊模型」如何決定Virgo 重力波干涉儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Site density fluctuations and the Newtonian-noise model” determines the key performance of “Virgo gravitational-wave interferometer”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地面的地震波使附近岩土的密度分佈隨時間變化，對測試質量產生直接的重力擾動，這種牛頓雜訊無法用任何機械隔振擋住，只能靠地震計陣列估算並從資料中減除，或把偵測器建在地下。對 Virgo 而言，牛頓雜訊在 10–20 Hz 與懸吊熱雜訊、控制雜訊同為低頻的邊界；此外散射光從真空管壁或擋板回到主光束會以非線性方式注入相位雜訊，磁場起伏則透過致動器磁鐵耦合，這些環境項都要以感測器陣列監測並計算耦合係數。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「站址密度起伏與牛頓雜訊模型」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Seismic waves make the density distribution of nearby soil and rock vary in time, which perturbs the test masses gravitationally; this Newtonian noise cannot be blocked by any mechanical isolation and can only be estimated with seismometer arrays and subtracted from the data, or avoided by going underground. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Site density fluctuations and the Newtonian-noise model”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 牛頓雜訊、散射光與環境耦合：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：表面波牛頓雜訊的量級估計 h_NN ≈ [4πGρ/(L·(2πf)²)]·ξ(f)·β，β 為量級為 1 的幾何因子。取 ρ = 1800 kg/m³、G = 6.67×10⁻¹¹ 得 4πGρ ≈ 1.5×10⁻⁶ s⁻²；f = 10 Hz 時 (2πf)² ≈ 3950，地面位移 ξ = 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz：h_NN ≈ 1.5×10⁻⁶/3950×10⁻⁹/3000 ≈ 1.3×10⁻²²/√Hz；f = 20 Hz、ξ = 3×10⁻¹⁰ 時約 1×10⁻²³/√Hz。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Deploy tens of seismometers around the end stations, measure the coherence length and propagation direction of seismic waves and use Wiener filtering to estimate the fraction of Newtonian noise that can be subtracted from the strain data; for scattered light, shake a baffle or a tube section deliberately, watch the arch-shaped features that appear in the strain spectrum and compute the coupling coefficient.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Newtonian-calibrator rotor” determines the key performance of “Virgo gravitational-wave interferometer”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Virgo 除了以輻射壓推動末端鏡的光子校正器，還發展牛頓校正器（NCal）：在末端鏡外數公尺處放置內含偏心質量的轉子，以穩定轉速旋轉，對鏡子產生頻率為轉速兩倍的重力作用力，其大小只由質量、幾何與萬有引力常數決定，不經過任何光學或電子鏈路，是與光子校正器完全獨立的絕對刻度。兩種校正器注入不同頻率的連續校正線，離線分析用它們追蹤讀出鏈增益並給出應變資料的振幅、相位與時間不確定度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「牛頓校正器轉子」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

The two calibrators inject continuous lines at different frequencies, which offline analysis uses to track readout gain and to state the amplitude, phase and timing uncertainty of the strain data. steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Order of magnitude: a rotor with two masses m at radius r, a distance d from the mirror centre, exerts on a mirror of mass M a force at twice the rotation frequency of F ≈ 3GMm·r²/d⁴.

steps.title: 校正：光子校正器與牛頓校正器：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：量級估計：兩個質量 m 在半徑 r 旋轉、距離鏡心 d 的轉子，對質量 M 的鏡子產生二倍頻力 F ≈ 3GMm·r²/d⁴。取 M = 42 kg、m = 1 kg、r = 0.1 m、d = 1.7 m：F ≈ 3×6.67×10⁻¹¹×42×0.01/8.35 ≈ 1.0×10⁻¹¹ N。轉速 18 Hz 時力的頻率 36 Hz，鏡子位移 x = F/(M(2πf)²) = 1.0×10⁻¹¹/(42×5.1×10⁴) ≈ 4.7×10⁻¹⁸ m，應變 h = x/L ≈ 1.6×10⁻²¹，比 36 Hz 處的雜訊高一個數量級以上，可做為清楚的校正線。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。

At 18 Hz rotation the force is at 36 Hz, the mirror moves x = F/(M(2πf)²) = 1.0×10⁻¹¹/(42×5.1×10⁴) ≈ 4.7×10⁻¹⁸ m and the strain is h = x/L ≈ 1.6×10⁻²¹, more than an order of magnitude above the noise at 36 Hz, a clear calibration line. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 量級估計：兩個質量 m 在半徑 r 旋轉、距離鏡心 d 的轉子，對質量 M 的鏡子產生二倍頻力 F ≈ 3GMm·r²/d⁴。取 M = 42 kg、m = 1 kg、r = 0.1 m、d = 1.7 m：F ≈ 3×6.67×10⁻¹¹×42×0.01/8.35 ≈ 1.0×10⁻¹¹ N。轉速 18 Hz 時力的頻率 36 Hz，鏡子位移 x = F/(M(2πf)²) = 1.0×10⁻¹¹/(42×5.1×10⁴) ≈ 4.7×10⁻¹⁸ m，應變 h = x/L ≈ 1.6×10⁻²¹，比 36 Hz 處的雜訊高一個數量級以上，可做為清楚的校正線。
knowledge.textEn: Order of magnitude: a rotor with two masses m at radius r, a distance d from the mirror centre, exerts on a mirror of mass M a force at twice the rotation frequency of F ≈ 3GMm·r²/d⁴. With M = 42 kg, m = 1 kg, r = 0.1 m and d = 1.7 m: F ≈ 3×6.67×10⁻¹¹×42×0.01/8.35 ≈ 1.0×10⁻¹¹ N. At 18 Hz rotation the force is at 36 Hz, the mirror moves x = F/(M(2πf)²) = 1.0×10⁻¹¹/(42×5.1×10⁴) ≈ 4.7×10⁻¹⁸ m and the strain is h = x/L ≈ 1.6×10⁻²¹, more than an order of magnitude above the noise at 36 Hz, a clear calibration line.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

steps.title: 超高真空、殘氣相位雜訊與基礎設施：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Ultra-high vacuum, residual-gas phase noise and infrastructure: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「1.2 m 真空管與 150 °C 烘烤」如何決定Virgo 重力波干涉儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “1.2 m vacuum tubes and 150 °C bake-out” determines the key performance of “Virgo gravitational-wave interferometer”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Virgo 的兩條 3 km 真空管直徑 1.2 m，總體積約數千立方公尺，是歐洲最大的超高真空系統之一；管壁經過約 150 °C 的烘烤以釋出氫氣，再由渦輪分子泵、離子泵與管端的低溫捕集器維持 10⁻⁹ mbar 等級的壓力。殘留分子以熱速度穿越光束時，其極化率使局部折射率隨機起伏，造成與分子數密度平方根成正比的相位雜訊；壓力每升高百倍，此雜訊升高十倍，因此真空是靈敏度的直接組成部分，而非只是避免散射的附帶條件。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「1.2 m 真空管與 150 °C 烘烤」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Virgo's two 3 km vacuum tubes are 1.2 m in diameter with a total volume of several thousand cubic metres, one of the largest ultra-high-vacuum systems in Europe; the walls were baked at about 150 °C to release hydrogen, and turbomolecular pumps, ion pumps and cryogenic traps at the tube ends hold pressures at the 10⁻⁹ mbar level. Residual molecules crossing the beam at thermal speed carry a polarisability that makes the local refractive index fluctuate randomly, producing phase noise proportional to the square root of the number density; every hundredfold rise in pressure raises this noise tenfold, so the vacuum is a direct component of sensitivity rather than a mere precaution against scatter. steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: An approximate residual-gas phase noise is S_x ≈ 4(2πα)²·n·L/(v₀·w), with α the molecular polarisability volume, n the number density, v₀ the thermal speed and w the beam radius.

steps.instruction: 以殘氣分析儀（RGA）量各管段的氣體組成，確認 H₂ 為主而碳氫化合物極低；記錄烘烤前後的出氣率與壓力曲線，並在觀測期間監測壓力與應變雜訊的相關性，例如刻意暫停一台泵使壓力升高十倍，應變譜在高頻應上升約 √10 ≈ 3.2 倍。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the gas composition of each tube section with a residual-gas analyser, confirming hydrogen dominance and very low hydrocarbons; log outgassing rates and pressure curves before and after bake-out, and during observation monitor the correlation between pressure and strain noise, for example by pausing one pump so pressure rises tenfold, when the high-frequency strain spectrum should rise by about √10 ≈ 3.2. steps.title: 超高真空、殘氣相位雜訊與基礎設施：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ultra-high vacuum, residual-gas phase noise and infrastructure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「1.2 m 真空管與 150 °C 烘烤」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “1.2 m vacuum tubes and 150 °C bake-out” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 一個閥門墊圈的微漏讓空氣進入某段真空管，壓力從 10⁻⁹ 升到 10⁻⁷ mbar，殘氣雜訊升高十倍並在高頻形成平台，同時水氣沉積到鏡面提高散射；若監測只看總壓而不看組成，漏氣與出氣會被混淆而延誤修復。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A micro-leak at a valve gasket lets air into one tube section and the pressure rises from 10⁻⁹ to 10⁻⁷ mbar; residual-gas noise grows tenfold and forms a high-frequency plateau while water deposits on the mirrors and raises scatter. Monitoring only total pressure rather than composition confuses a leak with outgassing and delays the repair. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：殘留分子以熱速度穿越光束時，其極化率使局部折射率隨機起伏，造成與分子數密度平方根成正比的相位雜訊；壓力每升高百倍，此雜訊升高十倍，因此真空是靈敏度的直接組成部分，而非只是避免散射的附帶條件。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Residual molecules crossing the beam at thermal speed carry a polarisability that makes the local refractive index fluctuate randomly, producing phase noise proportional to the square root of the number density; every hundredfold rise in pressure raises this noise tenfold, so the vacuum is a direct component of sensitivity rather than a mere precaution against scatter.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「真空只是為了避免灰塵與空氣散射，對雜訊曲線沒有直接貢獻。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Vacuum only keeps dust and air scatter away and has no direct place in the noise curve." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

steps.title: 網路觀測、天區定位與工程交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Network observing, sky localisation and engineering handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「三站網路時間延遲與運行交接」如何決定Virgo 重力波干涉儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Three-detector time delays and run handoff” determines the key performance of “Virgo gravitational-wave interferometer”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Virgo 的科學價值很大一部分來自與兩座 LIGO 組成的三站網路：訊號到達三站的時間差決定波源在天上的位置，三站的振幅比與相位差再縮小區域並給出極化資訊。2017 年 8 月的雙中子星事件 GW170817 正是因為加入 Virgo 才把定位縮到約 30 平方度，使光學望遠鏡能找到對應的電磁訊號。運行交接因此包含與其他站共享的校正模型、GPS 對時、資料品質旗標與低延遲警報鏈，而不僅是本站的靈敏度紀錄。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「三站網路時間延遲與運行交接」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

The binary-neutron-star event GW170817 in August 2017 was localised to about 30 square degrees only because Virgo was part of the network, which let optical telescopes find its electromagnetic counterpart. Run handoff therefore includes the calibration model shared with the other sites, GPS timing, data-quality flags and the low-latency alert chain, not only the local sensitivity record. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Three-detector time delays and run handoff”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：到達時間的量測精度 σ_t ≈ 1/(2π·SNR·σ_f)，σ_f 為訊號的有效頻寬：SNR = 10、σ_f = 100 Hz 時 σ_t ≈ 1.6×10⁻⁴ s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Arrival-time precision is σ_t ≈ 1/(2π·SNR·σ_f), with σ_f the effective signal bandwidth: for SNR = 10 and σ_f = 100 Hz, σ_t ≈ 1.6×10⁻⁴ s.

quiz.question: 關於「網路觀測、天區定位與工程交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Network observing, sky localisation and engineering handoff" is correct?

The difference between 3 km and 4 km arms is only site size, not sensitivity.

quiz.explanationEn: Much of Virgo's scientific value comes from forming a three-detector network with the two LIGO sites: the arrival-time differences fix the source position on the sky, and the amplitude ratios and phase differences between sites shrink the region further and give polarisation information. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 網路觀測、天區定位與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Network observing, sky localisation and engineering handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「三站網路時間延遲與運行交接」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Three-detector time delays and run handoff” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：到達時間的量測精度 σ_t ≈ 1/(2π·SNR·σ_f)，σ_f 為訊號的有效頻寬：SNR = 10、σ_f = 100 Hz 時 σ_t ≈ 1.6×10⁻⁴ s。Virgo 與漢福德相距約 8000 km（光程約 27 ms），角度精度 σ_θ ≈ c·σ_t/D ≈ 3×10⁸×1.6×10⁻⁴/8×10⁶ ≈ 6×10⁻³ rad ≈ 0.34°；兩條獨立基線使定位區域縮到數平方度到數十平方度，若只有兩站則退化為跨越數百平方度的環帶。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Arrival-time precision is σ_t ≈ 1/(2π·SNR·σ_f), with σ_f the effective signal bandwidth: for SNR = 10 and σ_f = 100 Hz, σ_t ≈ 1.6×10⁻⁴ s. Virgo and Hanford are about 8000 km apart (a light-travel time of about 27 ms), so the angular precision is σ_θ ≈ c·σ_t/D ≈ 3×10⁸×1.6×10⁻⁴/8×10⁶ ≈ 6×10⁻³ rad ≈ 0.34°; two independent baselines shrink the sky region to between a few and tens of square degrees, whereas two sites alone leave a ring spanning hundreds of square degrees. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以 GPS 鎖定的時間標記做端到端時序測試：在三站注入相同波形並設定已知的時間差，確認分析管線回復的時間差誤差小於 10 µs；運行前以模擬事件演練低延遲警報，量從資料到警報發出的延遲，並把校正不確定度、時序誤差與警報延遲列入網路交接紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run an end-to-end timing test with GPS-locked time stamps: inject the same waveform at the three sites with known time offsets and confirm that the analysis pipeline recovers the offsets to better than 10 µs; before the run rehearse low-latency alerts with simulated events, measure the delay from data to alert and enter calibration uncertainty, timing error and alert latency in the network handoff record.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 網路觀測、天區定位與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Network observing, sky localisation and engineering handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「三站網路時間延遲與運行交接」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Three-detector time delays and run handoff” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以 GPS 鎖定的時間標記做端到端時序測試：在三站注入相同波形並設定已知的時間差，確認分析管線回復的時間差誤差小於 10 µs；運行前以模擬事件演練低延遲警報，量從資料到警報發出的延遲，並把校正不確定度、時序誤差與警報延遲列入網路交接紀錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run an end-to-end timing test with GPS-locked time stamps: inject the same waveform at the three sites with known time offsets and confirm that the analysis pipeline recovers the offsets to better than 10 µs; before the run rehearse low-latency alerts with simulated events, measure the delay from data to alert and enter calibration uncertainty, timing error and alert latency in the network handoff record. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：某站的時間標記因 GPS 接收機韌體更新而偏移 1 ms，天區定位整體平移數度，電磁對應體的搜尋指向錯誤的天區；由於各站各自的靈敏度與校正都正常，錯誤只能靠網路層級的時序測試發現。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A 1 ms offset in one site's time stamps after a GPS-receiver firmware update shifts the sky localisation by several degrees and sends electromagnetic follow-up to the wrong region; because each site's sensitivity and calibration look normal, only a network-level timing test can reveal the error.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以 GPS 鎖定的時間標記做端到端時序測試：在三站注入相同波形並設定已知的時間差，確認分析管線回復的時間差誤差小於 10 µs；運行前以模擬事件演練低延遲警報，量從資料到警報發出的延遲，並把校正不確定度、時序誤差與警報延遲列入網路交接紀錄。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「網路觀測、天區定位與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Network observing, sky localisation and engineering handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
以 GPS 鎖定的時間標記做端到端時序測試：在三站注入相同波形並設定已知的時間差，確認分析管線回復的時間差誤差小於 10 µs。

optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.

Run an end-to-end timing test with GPS-locked time stamps: inject the same waveform at the three sites with known time offsets and confirm that the analysis pipeline recovers the offsets to better than 10 µs.

quiz.explanationEn: Run an end-to-end timing test with GPS-locked time stamps: inject the same waveform at the three sites with known time offsets and confirm that the analysis pipeline recovers the offsets to better than 10 µs; before the run rehearse low-latency alerts with simulated events, measure the delay from data to alert and enter calibration uncertainty, timing error and alert latency in the network handoff record. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 網路觀測、天區定位與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Network observing, sky localisation and engineering handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「三站網路時間延遲與運行交接」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Three-detector time delays and run handoff” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 某站的時間標記因 GPS 接收機韌體更新而偏移 1 ms，天區定位整體平移數度，電磁對應體的搜尋指向錯誤的天區；由於各站各自的靈敏度與校正都正常，錯誤只能靠網路層級的時序測試發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A 1 ms offset in one site's time stamps after a GPS-receiver firmware update shifts the sky localisation by several degrees and sends electromagnetic follow-up to the wrong region; because each site's sensitivity and calibration look normal, only a network-level timing test can reveal the error. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：運行交接因此包含與其他站共享的校正模型、GPS 對時、資料品質旗標與低延遲警報鏈，而不僅是本站的靈敏度紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Run handoff therefore includes the calibration model shared with the other sites, GPS timing, data-quality flags and the low-latency alert chain, not only the local sensitivity record.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「三站的靈敏度加總才是重點，定位只是附帶的好處。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "What matters is the summed sensitivity of three sites; localisation is just a side benefit." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.
